response.text: One journal (1406) is unbalanced by 36.00, and one paid invoice doesn't match its payments. I'll look at those two specifically, plus the AP journal mapping.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'jrnl_1406' AS k, l."LN_SEQ"::text AS a, l."ACCT_CD" AS b, l."DR_AMT"::text AS c, l."CR_AMT"::text AS d FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=1406 UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_paid_mismatch', i."INV_ID"::text, i."INV_AMT"::text, COALESCE((SELECT SUM("PAY_AMT") FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID"),0)::text, i."JRNL_NO"::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM("PAY_AMT") FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID"),0)<>i."INV_AMT" UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_jrnl_sample', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."REF_JRNL_NO"::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='AP' AND h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP' ORDER BY "JRNL_NO" LIMIT 3) UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_inv_jrnl_lines', COUNT(*)::text, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_ID"=1);
